svg.text: PR #2227 · Add federation discovery endpoint
Linked clients could not discover a portal's identity or protocol before enrollment.
A public discovery endpoint now reports a stable instance and supported protocol range.
BEFORE
AFTER
No discovery endpoint
A remote client has no federation handshake.
Release versions do not define protocol compatibility.
No portal instance identity
Origin alone cannot identify a replaced instance.
There is no stable server-side federation identifier.
No capability negotiation
Clients cannot distinguish missing implementations.
Guessing support would enable incomplete flows.
GET /api/federation/discovery
Unauthenticated and readable across origins.
Returns FederationDiscoveryResponse.
portal_instance
Singleton migration seeds a persistent UUID.
Repeated discovery returns the same instance_id.
FEDERATION_PROTOCOL + highest_common
Clients can reject non-overlapping protocol ranges.
Capabilities and auth modes are intentionally empty.
Discovery alone enables no linking, enrollment, credentials or tickets. Advertise capabilities only after enforcement lands.
